scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:worker && pnpm build:geometry
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @madori/contracts typecheck && pnpm --filter @madori/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @madori/worker typecheck && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm test:rust
scripts.check: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm check:fast && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:worker && pnpm build:geometry && pnpm test:rust && pnpm check:policy && pnpm check:secrets && pnpm smoke
scripts.dev: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:web && node scripts/dev.ts
scripts.setup: mise install && pnpm setup:wasm && pnpm build:wasm && pnpm --filter @madori/worker types && pnpm exec lefthook install
scripts.lint:config: mise exec -- actionlint && mise exec -- hadolint apps/geometry/Dockerfile
scripts.check:unused: knip && mise exec -- cargo machete apps/geometry crates/housing crates/modeling crates/viewer
scripts.check:policy: node scripts/check-licenses.ts && mise exec -- cargo deny --locked check bans licenses sources
scripts.check:security: pnpm check:secrets && pnpm audit --audit-level low && mise exec -- cargo deny --locked check advisories
scripts.check:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:rust && pnpm check:unused && pnpm lint:config && pnpm check:layout
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked -p madori-viewer --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --no-deps -- -D warnings
